title: I built a hyper realistic fighter jet simulator on three.js and it went viral on Twitter (25 thousand players in 2 weeks)!
author: aCakeShip
selftext:
[viperoneone.com](http://viperoneone.com/)

Hi hi solo dev here folks! It's been super fun building this in public. It went viral about 2 weeks ago with 25,000 players playing this over that time period with 1 thousand daily flyers! Thanks a ton to threejs as well for re-tweeting all my posts there and featuring my game on the front page of their website [threejs.org](http://threejs.org/)

Of the things that I obsessed over deeply while building the hyper real look:

* GoPro lens fitted to real cockpit footage, with the fisheye distortion and chromatic edges
* canopy scratches that catch the sun like real glass
* grade matched to the real clips with a fitted LUT
* fly through a cloud and water beads up and streaks across the canopy

AMA I'm super down to share more details on all the little things I made sure to pay attention to and how i built this!
